candidates.name: Portal: official search of part with priority
verified_facts: The portal workflow supports an official search with priority over part of registered land for a pending transaction.
The search defines transaction-priority protection and uses plan/extent information to identify the searched part.
semantic_limits: Transaction-priority protection and searched-plan extent do not provide a field survey, terrain elevation or vertical-accuracy evidence.

candidates.name: Portal: official search of whole with priority
verified_facts: The portal workflow supports an official search with priority over the whole of a registered title for a pending transaction.
The resulting priority period concerns registration priority for the intended disposition.
semantic_limits: Search priority and title identity are legal transaction evidence and cannot be promoted to parcel elevation measurement or geometry accuracy.
